description:
Seo-hoon, who struggles with making decisions, reunites with his high school classmate Do-hyun after entering university. Handsome and decisive, Do-hyun declares that he’ll help Seo-hoon overcome his indecisiveness… and from that day on, Seo-hoon is dragged into all sorts of “balance games” with him, eventually leading to unexpected skinship. Amidst the confusion, Jae-woo, a junior he meets in a liberal arts class, also begins openly expressing his feelings for him?! Caught between the two, Seo-hoon faces the most difficult choice of his life—who will he choose?
